justification: Frontend display-only fixes on the Intelligence Brief page surfaced from the live screenshot: (1) units now sit with their value (Height '7 m', Lot Size '500 m²') instead of separate 'Height Units: m' rows; (2) long values (the DCP URL) wrap with break-words instead of overflowing/overlapping the next field; (3) empty '...reason' fields (e.g. the granny-flat SEPP ineligible reason when the lot is eligible) are hidden; (4) an aerial site image is added by reusing the existing AerialTile component (NSW SIX Maps 10cm, same source as the granny-flat tool) — no new data source. No data or logic change.

pre_impl.existing_data: SectionData renders each section field generically. The backend emits units as separate fields (height + height_units, lot_size + lot_size_units), reason fields that are null when not applicable, and long URL strings. The generic renderer showed each as its own row with no wrapping.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The renderer assumed one field per value; units belong with their value, an empty reason is noise, and a long URL needs to wrap. Confirmed from the live brief (Height Units row, overlapping DCP URL, 'SEPP Ineligible Reason: —').
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new component. SectionData builds a unitFor map from '<field>_units' entries and merges them; the entries filter also drops standalone units rows and empty reason rows; a small valueWithUnit helper appends the unit (never onto a dash); the value cells gain break-words.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No data or network change. valueWithUnit appends a unit only when present and the value is not a dash; a field without a unit renders exactly as before.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend only (TypeScript/React). unitFor is typed Record<string,string>; valueWithUnit takes (key, raw, unit?) and returns a string; the filter handles null/undefined/empty reason values.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: units floated as separate rows, the DCP URL overlapped the next field, and an empty ineligible-reason row added noise. After: '7 m'/'500 m²' read naturally, long values wrap, and empty reason rows are gone.

functions.name: valueWithUnit
functions.input: a field key, its raw value, and an optional unit string merged from the matching units field
functions.output: the formatted value with the unit appended, e.g. '7 m', unless the value is an empty dash
functions.if_none: with no unit, or when the formatted value is a dash, it returns the formatted value unchanged

values: N/A - no regulatory values. Units are display strings emitted by the backend (m, m²); the change only places them next to their value.
queries: N/A - frontend render change; no database or API query is added.

break_it.scenario: A field has a matching units field but a null value
break_it.what_happens: appending the unit would produce a meaningless '— m'
break_it.repro: valueWithUnit('height', null, 'm') returns the dash without the unit because the formatted value is a dash
break_it.how: the helper only appends the unit when the formatted value is not the em-dash placeholder

break_it.scenario: A value is a very long URL (the DCP plan link)
break_it.what_happens: an unwrapped long string overflows its cell and overlaps the adjacent field
break_it.repro: the value cell now carries break-words so the URL wraps within its column
break_it.how: break-words on the value dd wraps long unbroken strings instead of overflowing

break_it.scenario: A reason field is null because the condition does not apply (eligible lot)
break_it.what_happens: an empty 'Ineligible Reason: —' row adds confusing noise
break_it.repro: the entries filter drops keys matching /reason/i whose value is null, undefined or empty
break_it.how: empty reason rows are filtered out; a populated reason still renders

post_merge.manual_verify: On the brief, confirm Planning Controls reads 'Height 7 m' and 'Lot Size 500 m²' (no separate units rows), the DCP URL wraps instead of overlapping, and the granny-flat card no longer shows an empty 'SEPP Ineligible Reason'. The ANEF value and site-history depend on a clean Railway rebuild (ANEF #536 + rapidfuzz reinstall), not this change.
